memory_candidates.content: This repo's .claude/ directory is a disposable, gitignored deploy tree (see /.claude/ in .gitignore) regenerated from agent-system/extensions/{name}/ per the project-root .claude-extensions.json. Any edit intended to persist in git (skills, agents, docs, rules) must target the canonical source under agent-system/extensions/{extension}/... and should also be mirrored into the deployed .claude/ copy so the current session's live skill definitions match immediately without waiting for a redeploy. git status/git add on .claude/ paths will silently no-op or error ("paths are ignored").
